summary: Source-backed capacity boundary: no demonstrated issuer or race fence can establish the specified account-wide complete active/unknown provider-session snapshot. Preserve coverage=null/HOLD; a standalone adapter cannot honestly turn existing partial evidence into complete coverage. No code or live effects.
nextAction: Lead: decide whether true account-wide capacity is required or a specifically bounded, enforceably closed admission domain is acceptable. Commission provider-verified enumeration/lifecycle plus snapshot/event fence, or domain-wide admission fencing and initial reconciliation, and reconcile leases for integration; independently review before any activation. Keep current HOLD until evidence and separate provider first-connect/terminal authority exist.
evidence:
Inspected clean registered worktree reviewer2-stagec-19378518 (specified Stage C 19378518c5469b1dda8eeaa9b2cd9e3f7d2f8c82); read W23 checkpoint 13965 and W19 13915. Manual documented launch uses render + BrowserRunInNewTab (docs/ProjectLaunchTemplate.md:15-21). Server/McpTools.fs:2545-63 exposes generic per-project scripts; Client/SignalR/Client.fs:885-932 only calls beginAttributedLaunch for Some targetAgentId, enforces target by basename launchAgent.js, then runs generic source. :711-734 records initial outcomeUnknown in a project ledger, not account-wide provider inventory; :950-978 records UI/transport observations and preserves uncertain persistence. Other script names with no target are not attributed. BrowserExecuteFile is a separate generic script execution path (Server/McpTools.fs:2565-77; Client/SignalR/Client.fs:992-1013), and inline browser execution exists at McpTools.fs:2579-85. Scheduled generic execution invokes scheduler.Schedule without the attributed launch path (Client/SignalR/Client.fs:835-858; docs/BrowserOneShotScheduler.md:3-13), with persisted local schedule and arbitrary script. Manager documented journal is separate, with begin before browser and uncertain sends held (docs/ManagerHeartbeat.md:180-212). All these permit sends in principle without a shared account reservation gate; direct provider UI or other devices/services can initiate sessions outside Jarvis and are not shown to be observed. This is a source-evidenced coverage gap, not a claim that an external provider API cannot exist.
BrowserBridge.fs:226-249 stores bounded reported window snapshots per current connection and drops them on disconnect; :304-338 explicitly identifies transport provenance, not provider sessions or terminal authority. Client/Modules/NativeSchedulerAccountReservation.fs:222-253 verifies roster/account/project heads and 60s freshness, not provider membership; missing reservation document yields empty reservations only, not empty sessions. Program.fs:331-350 keeps native host disabled; AutomationNativeProviderSessionHost.fs:315-331 rejects first-connect dispatch and terminal release. HubService.fs:124-139 permits authenticated registered-client activity reads scoped to server-process coverage; absent or restarted activity is not inactivity. Thus account OAuth and roster completeness do not bind provider identity or fence external sends, and a project-head recheck cannot close an unrelated provider-event race.
Smallest feasible path: discover an existing authenticated provider authority able to enumerate the entire declared account scope, including external sessions, with durable identity, complete paging, lifecycle and snapshot/event watermark; bind issuer/account/projects/epochs and recheck generation, freshness, scope, heads and watermark at admission. Alternatively a product decision could narrow capacity to a controlled domain, but only if every sender in that defined domain is technically fenced through one shared durable account admission/CAS and preexisting/uncertain activity reconciled; this does not establish full provider-account capacity and a policy promise alone does not fence outside sends. Integrate at BrowserRunInNewTab handler :885-932, generic BrowserExecuteFile/ExecuteJs and scheduling paths, all registered clients/projects and any supported direct send paths, plus native dispatch; prevent races across enumeration/admission and restart. Those are outside the exclusive new-module/test lease and require Lead reconciliation. Exact contract: missing/partial/stale/disconnected/restarted, unknown identity, duplicates/conflicting association, unassociated activity or uncertain send cannot become free; correlate a uniquely proven original reservation at most once, keep unmatched reservations occupied, and require authenticated terminal/no-send proof. Persist/recover original effects without replay. Genuine integration tests must exercise multi-project and verified empty snapshots, external/concurrent sends, crashes, reconnect and event gaps using the real issuer/fence; a mock asserting completeness proves none of these. No source modifications, tests, review request, deploy or provider effects; first-connect/terminal and frozen planner publication remain separate dependencies.
